name: Vlad
source:
Vlad is a supreme god of some kind. He is [url=/c10671]Hayden[/url]'s younger brother and his only friend.
He has a light-as-a-cloud tone of voice and attitude.
His hobbies are gardening and cooking, in both of them he is extremely unskilled.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/sikkoku/t_top.html]the official website[/url].]
